description: Counterparty-risk verdict (allow, warn or block, with reasons) for an EVM address on Base, Ethereum, OP Mainnet, Arbitrum or Base Sepolia, for use before paying, approving or trusting it. Checks the OFAC SDN list and the Chainalysis sanctions oracle, account age, EOA or contract, EIP-7702 delegation, upgradeable proxies and code changes in the last 72 h, and token controls (mint, blacklist, pause, fees, owner). Price: $0.02 USDC per call (x402).

chain.description: EVM chain: ethereum, base, base-sepolia, optimism, arbitrum

codeWindowHours.description: warn when code or proxy implementation changed within this window (default 72)

minAgeDays.description: warn when the address is younger than this (default 7)
